items.claim: The front page clips its column on a short viewport and nothing scrolls
items.note: `.page` now has `overflow: auto`, so the page scrolls inside itself and the root still never scrolls. The repro is `apps/site/FrontPage/FrontPage.browser.test.tsx` at a 640×360 viewport. It checks that the wordmark is on screen, that the last link can be scrolled into view, and that `window.scrollY` stays 0.

items.claim: The Components and WeaselChart links show the front page again under the site's dev server
items.note:
The site's forwarding table is now one module, `scripts/vite-site-proxy.ts`, and it now forwards `/weasel/chart` as well as `/weasel/draw`.
  - Forge's dev base is `/`, so the dev server can't forward its built path unchanged. Instead, the front page and the sidebar's "UI catalog →" link (the same defect, in `WeaselDemos.tsx`) now both use the existing `FORGE_LAB.href` from `apps/shared/labs.ts`.
  - The repro is the new test "links only to apps the dev server can reach" in `apps/site/__tests__/FrontPage.test.tsx`; it failed on `/weasel/docs/ui/forge/` before the fix.
  - No changeset: only the site app changed, which no package consumer sees.

items.claim: The version pill's comment claims it follows the sidebar's placement
items.note: The sidebar's pill sits 10px up and 1px inside its wordmark's end, while the front page's sits 20px up and 17px past it. I removed the false comment and left the offsets alone, since the placement is a visual choice. A comment can't be tested, and nothing a consumer sees changed, so there is no changeset.
